phases.label: Scalp & outside the skull
phases.instruction: Sweep the scalp from vertex down to the skull base. Check both sides.

phases.label: Vertex, cortex & extra-axial spaces
phases.instruction: Compare both hemispheres, gray-white junctions and the inner table.

phases.label: Deep gray & insular ribbons
phases.instruction: Identify paired deep structures and compare each insular ribbon.

phases.label: Fissures, cisterns & arteries
phases.instruction: Look at CSF spaces, the MCA regions and midbrain configuration.

phases.label: Ventricles & midline
phases.instruction: Inspect septum position, occipital horns and temporal horns.

phases.label: Posterior fossa & foramen magnum
phases.instruction: Review the brainstem, cerebellum, CPA cisterns and craniocervical junction.

phases.label: Sella & orbits
phases.instruction: Check the sellar region and both orbits on axial soft-tissue views.

phases.label: Sagittal checks
phases.instruction: Use sagittal images for the pituitary, brainstem, tonsils, sinuses and optic nerves.

phases.label: Coronal checks
phases.instruction: Review venous sinuses, dural reflections and both convexities.

phases.label: Bones, mastoids & sinuses
phases.instruction: Switch to the bone reconstruction and review skull, temporal bones and sinuses.
